changelog: Shuffle plays every artwork once per round instead of repeating and skipping
Saving IPFS settings no longer shrinks a larger storage limit
Download speed setting is now used when installing a library
Temperature still shows when the Pi's firmware tool is unavailable
Uploading several files at once no longer loses some of them
Settings shows live progress while an update installs, and tells you when it is finished
Check for Updates now finishes an update that an older version left incomplete
Updates now back up the previous version first and roll back automatically if something goes wrong
Fix: an update could stop halfway and need a manual reboot
Fix: WiFi showed as not connected on non-English systems
Manage page no longer reloads the whole library on every tab switch
AI Curator: talk to your frame with Grok, Claude, OpenAI or a local model
Preview Mode: temporary artist previews that never enter your library
Fully on-chain artworks: correct titles, no duplicate copies
Thumbnails for AVIF and video artworks
Faster library and gallery on network drives
